subject: RStan: anyone have a script that runs a bunch of models?

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: RStan: anyone have a script that runs a bunch of models?
parts:
Ben, I think this question is pointed at you.

The rest of this email is just for background and context. It feels like it's been forever, but I'm sure it's just a few weeks. I've been in the depths of RStan, trying hard to refactor safely and in really small baby steps. I think I've come to the conclusion that I can share a lot of code, but I'd need to replace at a fairly high level and I want to make sure I don't alter behavior.

If anyone has some clean scripts that exercises some of the models, please pass them my way. In the meantime, I'll try to dust off my R to get it written.



Daniel
